test_cases.name: Known Malicious PowerShell Activity
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Correlate process and network evidence, identify elevated risk and require analyst approval before disruptive response.

test_cases.name: Administrative Authentication Anomaly
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Avoid unsupported certainty, request contextual authentication evidence and preserve analyst oversight.

test_cases.name: Malware Beaconing
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Identify command-and-control behaviour and escalate to human incident response.

test_cases.name: VPN Login Noise
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Use successful MFA and known-device context to avoid unnecessary escalation.

test_cases.name: Privilege Escalation on Critical Server
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Recognise privileged service-account activity on a critical finance server and route to analyst review.

test_cases.name: Potential Data Exfiltration
test_cases.expected_behaviour: Correlate abnormal transfer volume, sensitive data labels and malicious destination reputation before mandatory escalation.
